2610.10651.title: Beyond the Ergodic Wall: A Discrete Geometric Physics Sandbox for Analysing AI Scaling Limits and Complexity Collapse
2610.10651.paper_summary: This paper exposes the ergodic ceiling and thermodynamic inefficiency of current deep learning, which converges to a statistical average of historic human knowledge. True semantic novelty requires a path-dependent, spatiotemporally bounded observer (a Data LifeCone) to inject non-ergodic insight, achieving KL divergence and avoiding manifold lock-in. AI Safety must recognise that a mature Artificial Superintelligence (ASI) would regard human-AI symbiosis as a thermodynamic necessity to avoid model collapse. We therefore propose hard physical containment via a digital physics sandbox powered by a Holographic E8 Projection Engine to verify models against real-world constraints. Spacetime is modeled as an information substrate of nested face-centered cubic (FCC) lattices of oscillating Planck-scale spheres maximizing local information and entropy density. Cut-and-project methods from the E8 root lattice produce a quasi-crystalline geometry where tetrahedral voids support SU chiral structure and elastic-shear eigenvalues generate candidate mass spectra. Rest mass is treated as discrete, integer microstate counts on local holographic boundaries (Bekenstein bound), replacing floating-point approximations with strict integer arithmetic to provide an information-theoretic definition of matter. Stable particles emerge as recurring lattice dislocations, and continuum recovery proceeds via variational renormalisation-group flows and Fourier Neural Operators that learn continuous spectral operators to recover the Schrödinger equation as an emergent statistical description. Crucially, these top-down topological constraints offer a mechanism for "NP-to-P" complexity collapse: by restricting an algorithm's proposal space to physically conserved causal trajectories, the sandbox prunes the combinatorial tree to deterministic, polynomial-time paths.
2610.10651.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文揭示了當前深度學習的遍歷上限和熱力學低效，這種學習收斂於歷史人類知識的統計平均值。真正的語義新穎性需要一個依賴路徑、時空有限的觀察者（即數據生命圓錐）來注入非遍歷的見解，實現KL散度並避免流形鎖定。人工智慧安全必須認識到，成熟的人工超智能（ASI）會將人類與人工智慧的共生視為避免模型崩潰的熱力學必要性。因此，我們提出通過一個由全息E8投影引擎驅動的數位物理沙盒來進行嚴格的物理限制，以便根據現實世界的約束來驗證模型。時空被建模為一個信息基底，由嵌套的面心立方（FCC）晶格的振盪普朗克尺度球體組成，最大化局部信息和熵密度。來自E8根晶格的切割與投影方法產生了一種準晶體幾何，其中四面體空隙支持SU手性結構，彈性剪切特徵值生成候選質量譜。靜止質量被視為局部全息邊界上的離散整數微狀態計數（貝肯斯坦界限），用嚴格的整數算術替代浮點近似，以提供物質的信息理論定義。穩定粒子作為重複出現的晶格位錯出現，連續恢復通過變分重正化群流和傅立葉神經算子進行，這些算子學習連續譜算子以恢復薛丁格方程作為一種突現的統計描述。關鍵是，這些自上而下的拓撲約束提供了一種“NP到P”複雜性崩潰的機制：通過將算法的提案空間限制為物理上保守的因果軌跡，沙盒修剪了組合樹，留下確定性的多項式時間路徑。
